recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male artist in a denim shirt, positioned off-center against a studio background featuring musical equipment, utilizing a cool-to-warm split-tone color grade and bold, slanted custom typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned left-of-center balanced by large typography on the right
Cool blue shadows in the denim and hair contrasting with warm cream highlights in the background
Sharp focus on the subject's face against a soft-focus background of curtains and amplifiers
coreInvariants: Denim western-style shirt with visible pearl snaps
Pompadour or quiff hairstyle with textured volume

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, waist-up, looking slightly off-camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white logo-like text in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the shoulders to the right, and lands on the slanted text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space in the upper right, filled by typography and soft curtain textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and slate blue in the shadows and midtones of the subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm cream and pale beige in the background highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the graphic typography to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high tonal contrast between the dark subject and light background.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with uniform stroke thickness
Integrated horizontal bars that extend into decorative underlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' and 'T' have elongated horizontal strokes that act as framing devices for the rest of the word.

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating over the background, partially overlapping the subject's shoulder area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom display face used for both name components to create a unified brand mark.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight as a base skeleton.
Required to achieve the specific interlocking horizontal bars.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A portrait of a man with a quiff hairstyle wearing a denim shirt, standing in a music studio. Behind him is a cream curtain and a blurred electric guitar and amplifier. Apply a split-tone filter with blue shadows and cream highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of bold, white, all-caps sans-serif text in the upper right. Slant the text 15 degrees upward. Extend the bottom stroke of the last letter in the top row to underline the first word, and extend the top stroke of the first letter in the bottom row to overline the second word.

verificationChecks: Is the color grade distinctly blue in the shadows?
Is the text slanted upwards at a consistent angle?
Does the subject appear in sharp focus compared to the background?
Are the pearl snaps on the denim shirt visible?

adjustableVariables: Blur depth of the background equipment
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact brand logos on the musical equipment
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the denim texture is clearly defined.
Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the split-tone effect creates a professional 'studio' atmosphere.
Confirm the typography feels integrated rather than just pasted on.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Male Artist) + Wardrobe(Denim) + Lighting(Split-tone Blue/Cream) + Layout(Asymmetrical) + Typography(Slanted Bold Sans-Serif Custom).
